title: Routing-state convergence audit, telemetry enrichment, and rollback safeguards
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Summary: On 2026-03-09 a routing-policy rollout across three regions produced transient request-level disagreements about model variant selection (requests for the same route diverged between v1-q4 and v1-q2). The event lasted ~48 minutes and manifested as increased token error rates and an elevation in 5xx / fallback-to-default-model occurrences. This ticket tracks the audit, immediate mitigations, telemetry work, and durable rollback/safeguard features to avoid recurrence.
timeline: 2026-03-09T02:11Z - First spike detected: 5xx rate for route /generate increased from 0.3% to 3.7% in region us-west-2
2026-03-09T02:15Z - On-call alerted via PagerDuty; initial mitigation: temporarily disabled recent policy change in us-west-2
2026-03-09T02:26Z - Cross-region reroute observed as policy propagation collided with stale local cache in eu-central-1
2026-03-09T03:00Z - Automated fallback to 'default-llama-q2' triggered for high-latency requests; error rate partially reduced
2026-03-09T03:20Z - Full rollback of the release across regions completed; normal error rates restored by 03:59Z
2026-03-09T04:10Z - Post-incident incident channel opened; initial RCA scoped to policy-store write ordering and lack of convergence checks
impact: Customer-facing: increased generation failures for 3.1% of requests on affected routes for ~48 minutes. Internal: spike in retries, billing anomalies for retried tokens, and elevated on-call load. A handful of SRE-run tests for Dedicated pools reported degraded tail latency during the event.
detection: Automated SLO alerting (route-level 5xx) and anomalous rise in fallback-to-default metric. Blind spots identified: lack of fine-grained variant-decision logs tying request IDs to policy version and the absence of a convergence monitor for policy rolls.
root_cause: Race between cross-region policy propagation and local policy cache invalidation combined with an entropy-seed mismatch in the variant resolution algorithm. Two concurrent updates (policy weight adjustments + region-scoped override) were applied within a 90s window. Some edge routers read an intermediate policy version while others read the new version, producing inconsistent variant selection for the same request attributes.
resolution: Immediate: rolled back the policy to the previous stable commit and invalidated local caches across regions. Restored normal traffic by 03:59Z. Medium-term: hot-fix deployed to ensure policy-store writes include monotonically increasing version stamps and force-version headers for reads during rollouts.
action_items: A1: Add deterministic policy version handshake — require read ops to include 'policy_version' header during rollout windows; if mismatch, route to local canary queue instead of making live variant decision. Owner: Diego Ramirez. Due: 2026-03-18

A2: Telemetry enrichment — log request_id -> variant_decision -> policy_version for all routed requests (sample 100% for 72 hours post-release; long-term 1% sampling). Owner: R&D telemetry (Maya Chen). Due: 2026-03-21

A3: Implement convergence monitor — a controller that verifies per-route policy version consistency across edge nodes and raises an automated pause if divergence > 5% for > 30s. Owner: SRE infra (Liam O'Connor). Due: 2026-03-28

A4: Rollout gating — extend rollout CLI to provide caution windows: enforce 'staggered propagation' that delays non-overlapping region writes by at least 3 minutes or use transactional propagation. Owner: Release Engineering. Due: 2026-04-04

A5: Simulation harness — build a routing policy simulator to test concurrent writes, cache invalidation races, and entropy-seed scenarios before release. Owner: Serving runtime team (Priya Singh). Due: 2026-04-11

A6: Circuit-breaker on fallback storms — add tokenized rate-limiting for automatic fallback-to-default transitions to avoid retry amplification. Owner: Runtime reliability (Diego Ramirez). Due: 2026-03-25
A7: Postmortem dashboard — publish a dedicated Grafana panel linking policy_version drift, variant_mismatch_rate, and fallback_rate for on-call. Owner: Observability (Evan Brooks). Due: 2026-03-17
followups: F1: Run two controlled rollouts that exercise the new deterministic version handshake and convergence monitor in staging and canary clusters; produce a short report. Owner: Diego Ramirez. Due: 2026-03-30
F2: Update our incident playbook with explicit checks for 'policy-version skew' and steps to force consistent reads. Owner: SRE. Due: 2026-03-20
F3: Coordinate a cross-team retro with Release Eng, Serving Runtime, SRE, and Observability to validate rollout cadence and gating changes. Owner: Product (Samira Gopal). Due: 2026-03-22
